excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]中大部分虚拟人口已经突破我们的防火墙，以一连串的数据和乱码的方式从我们手上逃脱。
excerpt.en: The mostly virtual population of [Root.GetName] has broken through our firewalls and escaped from our grasp in a burst of data and nonsense code.
